title: Fix Polish equator and hemisphere queries
body:
EQUATOR & HEMISPHERE QUESTION RESOLUTION
- Fixed Polish colloquial equator queries: 'nad równikiem', 'powyżej równika', and 'na północ od równika' now accurately resolve to north of the equator (coordinates.latitude > 0) instead of mistranslating to 'on the equator'.
- Added corresponding resolution for 'pod równikiem', 'poniżej równika', and 'na południe od równika' (coordinates.latitude < 0).
- Added explicit Gemini prompt guidance clarifying that in Polish, 'nad równikiem' means situated above/north of the equator, preventing unintended 'on the equator' literal mistranslations.
- Verified with automated tests across northern and southern hemisphere countries.
